info.title: caic API Reference
info.description:
RESTful JSON API served at `/api/caic/v1/`. SSE endpoints stream newline-delimited JSON events.

The read-only MCP tool `get_system_stats` takes `{}` and returns `SystemStatsResp`, the same snapshot as `GET /api/caic/v1/server/system-stats` (SDK method `getSystemStats`). It requires the explicitly granted `caic:server.admin` OAuth scope and is unavailable to task-scoped agents. Browser sessions and auth-disabled local clients retain full permissions. The global task-list SSE emits compact `health` events with `ServerHealth` on connection and each five-second collection, only to clients with server-admin permission; no health data enters individual task streams or logs. `cpuPerc` sums logical-CPU utilization (100% per CPU); `cpuCount` is machine capacity. `cpuLevel` and `memLevel` classify the latest successful sample as `warning` from 80% of machine capacity and `high` from 90%, and are omitted before the first successful sample, `cpuLevel` also while `cpuCount` is zero; CPU and memory high flags are true at `warning` or `high`. Sampling errors or collection gaps retain the last observed levels, flags, and readings; `time` is omitted before the first success. Retained readings accompany errors but do not represent current utilization. The tasks SSE stream emits a heartbeat every 15 seconds independently of sampling; clients detect missing stream traffic separately from resource warnings. The subscribable MCP resource `caic://system/health` exposes the same `ServerHealth` data, requires `caic:server.admin`, and is unavailable to task-scoped agents; subscriptions notify on each sampling result, with independent 15-second keepalives. `samples` contains up to 60 five-second observations, oldest first; the array is empty until the first successful collection. Optional `error` reports a sampling warning while retained samples remain readable. Each `cpus` entry has a stable logical CPU ID and `usagePerc` from 0–100%. Its array length is the online CPU count; sum the percentages for total usage (100% per fully busy CPU), or divide that sum by 100 for CPU equivalents. Task `EventStats.cpuPerc` uses the same total-usage convention; `cpuCeiling` is the configured upper bound in fractional CPU units, derived from the owning runtime logical CPU count, explicit quota, and configured CPU set; null means unknown. Inherited cgroup limits and process affinity are unreported, so effective task capacity is unknown. `runtimeCPUs` is the owning runtime logical CPU count, including remote/VM runtimes; null means unknown. `cpuQuota` preserves the explicit fractional quota: zero means no explicit quota, null means unknown. `cpuError` reports runtime metadata observation failures while usage remains readable. CPU configuration refreshes every 30 seconds during active streams; task aggregate stats do not reveal per-CPU distribution. Memory excludes available/reclaimable pages. Memory, network counters, and filesystem capacities use bytes. Network sums all interfaces and can count traffic on multiple interfaces; disk covers the server working-directory filesystem.

post.description: Creates a task to fix a failing CI pipeline.
Injects a CI fix command into an existing task's PR.

get.description: Returns the log tail of a failed CI check run.
Lists the authenticated user's connected OAuth clients.

post.description: Revokes one connected OAuth client grant for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the list of running processes inside the task's runtime instance.

post.description: Sends SIGTERM or SIGKILL to a process inside the task's runtime instance.

get.description: Returns the latest size snapshot for well-known caches.
Lists well-known cache configurations.
Returns server capabilities and feature flags.
Lists available coding agent harnesses.

post.description: Refreshes one coding agent model inventory, bypassing its cache.

get.description: Returns aggregated operation latency statistics.
Returns server and per-repository preferences.

post.description: Updates server settings and preferences.

get.description: Lists all discovered repositories.

post.description: Clones a repository into the server's root directory.

get.description: Lists branches for a repository.
Returns one runtime's specialized image refresh progress.

post.description: Rebuilds one runtime's specialized image and updates its installed coding agents.

get.description: Returns recent whole-machine utilization samples.
Describes the active Tailscale API access token without revealing it. Requires administrator authority.

post.description: Verifies a Tailscale API access token with Tailscale and saves it in place of the configured one. Requires administrator authority.
Removes the saved Tailscale API access token, falling back to the configured one. Requires administrator authority.
Saves the Tailscale tags of new tasks' nodes. Requires administrator authority.
Triggers a background server auto-update to the latest release.

get.description: Returns the current server version and checks for available updates.
Returns all tasks.

post.description: Creates and starts a new coding agent task. Images use multipart/form-data; see InputImage.

get.description: Streams task list updates for all tasks via SSE.
Returns a single task by id (404 if it does not exist).

post.description: Clears context and restarts the agent session without a prompt.
Sends a compact command to reduce the agent's context window usage.

get.description: Returns repository status and the unified diff for a task's branch.
Returns one committed or uncommitted file patch.
Returns repository and changed-file metadata without loading patch bodies.

post.description: Forks a task by snapshotting its runtime instance and creating a new task on a derived branch.

get.description: Builds an editable handoff prompt for continuing a task in a fresh agent session.
Streams mutable pricing estimates in one fold over raw records 1 through the requested snapshot end; do not reprice each chunk independently.

Streams strictly after an opaque raw-record cursor. Initial cursor query is overridden by Last-Event-ID on reconnect. Every connection sends a bounded statsSnapshot before history, followed by live stats revisions; neither carries a raw ID. Checkpoints advance through outputless records and repeat every 15 seconds to prove liveness. Close and rediscover bootstrap on reset/error.
Returns root context summaries, compact task metadata, and exact discovery without downloading archived transcripts.

Returns root turn n's timeline, counted from 1 across context sections: tool calls, subagents, detached commands, and inferred model time on one axis relative to the turn start, plus per-call token usage and per-tool time. n is a completed turn or the manifest's running turn, whose timeline grows until it completes. It is mutable: subagents and commands started in the turn can end later, and cost estimates follow current prices. Archived sections need no transcript download. An optional generation must match the manifest bootstrap.

Returns a native subagent body through a finite raw prefix. Optional afterRecordID and afterIndex must be paired and select an exclusive suffix; index 4294967295 skips the whole record. Current status belongs to manifest metadata.
Returns only root provisioning logs and the initial session init through a finite prefix, excluding interleaved conversation payloads.

Returns an immutable inclusive normalized-position slice, excluding adjacent outputs within the same raw record. FirstIndex zero starts at a physical record even when it has no outputs. LastIndex may be end to include the entire last physical record, including one with no outputs. This permits stable fixed-record pages inside a section; use exact section positions at its edges.
Returns recorded and observed runtime metadata for a task.

post.description: Sends user input immediately, or appends it to the pending prompt for the next waiting turn. Images use multipart/form-data; see InputImage.
Cancels a queued prompt before delivery.
Stops a task, then deletes its runtime instance after the configured recovery window unless revived.

get.description: Returns compact Git state for every repository mapped to a task.

post.description: Restarts a completed or errored task with a new prompt. Images use multipart/form-data; see InputImage.
Reconnects to an orphaned task runtime instance.
Requests graceful stop of a running task.
Pushes task changes to the remote repository.
Cancels the task's running sync. Responds 409 when no sync is running.

get.description: Returns full tool input; source query parameters disambiguate provider-local IDs across owners and turns.
Returns current usage quota statistics.
Returns daily cross-task usage rollups for the usage dashboard.
Streams changed usage quota snapshots and a heartbeat every 15 seconds via SSE.

AntigravitySettings.description: AntigravitySettings holds account settings for Antigravity tasks.

AskOption.description: AskOption is a single option in an AskUserQuestion.

AskQuestion.description: AskQuestion is a single question from AskUserQuestion.

AuthBootstrapResp.description:
AuthBootstrapResp is injected into the SPA document before the frontend
hydrates. It mirrors the auth-related fields otherwise fetched from
/server-info/config and /auth/me.

BotFixCIReq.description:
BotFixCIReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/bot/fix-ci.
The server fetches CI logs, builds a prompt, and creates a fix task.

BotFixPRReq.description:
BotFixPRReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/bot/fix-pr.
The server fetches CI logs for the task's PR and injects a fix command.

BranchAction.description: BranchAction describes how a newly created task will use a selected branch.

BranchInfo.description: BranchInfo describes a single branch with its origin and task-creation action.

CILogResp.description:
CILogResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/ci-log.
It contains the name of the first failed CI step and its log tail.

CIStatus.description: CIStatus is the CI check state for a task or repo default branch.

CPUUsage.description: CPUUsage measures one logical CPU over the sampling interval.

usagePerc.description: 100% means this logical CPU was fully busy.

CacheMappingResp.description: CacheMappingResp represents a directory mapping for cache/state sharing.

containerPath.description: ContainerPath is optional; empty uses the matching home-relative HostPath.

resolvedContainerPath.description: ResolvedContainerPath is the runtime target after applying the ContainerPath default.

CacheSize.description: CacheSize describes the most recent size snapshot for a well-known cache.

CacheSizesResp.description: CacheSizesResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/server/cache-sizes.

CancelQueuedInputReq.description: CancelQueuedInputReq identifies a pending prompt to cancel.

CheckConclusion.description: CheckConclusion is the conclusion of a completed CI check run.

CheckStatus.description: CheckStatus is the status of a CI check run.

autoCompactTokenLimit.description:
AutoCompactTokenLimit is the threshold in tokens. Zero uses the harness
default; changes apply to new tasks.

CloneRepoReq.description: CloneRepoReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/server/repos.

path.description: Target subdirectory under rootDir; defaults to repo basename.

autoCompactTokenLimit.description:
AutoCompactTokenLimit is the total active context threshold in tokens.
Zero uses the harness default; changes apply to new tasks.

CompactReq.description: CompactReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/compact.

Config.description: Config reports server capabilities to the frontend.

tailscaleAvailableUntil.description:
TailscaleAvailableUntil is when new tasks stop being able to enable
Tailscale, ahead of the API access token expiry. Zero when Tailscale is
unavailable or the token never expires.

CreateTaskReq.description: CreateTaskReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks.

resumeSessionID.description: Opaque harness-native session ID; the session must be accessible in the new runtime.

DiffFileStat.description:
DiffFileStat describes changes to a single file. LinesAdded and LinesDeleted
count text lines. OldSize and NewSize report byte sizes for binary files and
are -1 for text files, with 0 on the side where the path is added or removed.

newSize.description: NewSize is the binary post-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

oldSize.description: OldSize is the binary pre-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

DiffIndexCommit.description: DiffIndexCommit describes one commit and its changed-file metadata.

behind.description: Present on the comparison branch and missing from HEAD.

DiffIndexFileStat.description: DiffIndexFileStat describes a committed file without its patch body.

newSize.description: NewSize is the binary post-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

oldSize.description: OldSize is the binary pre-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

DiffIndexFileStatus.description: DiffIndexFileStatus describes one uncommitted path without its patch body.

newSize.description: NewSize is the binary post-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

oldSize.description: OldSize is the binary pre-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

DiffIndexRepository.description: DiffIndexRepository describes one repository in a diff index.

repository.description: Repository indexes the task's mapped repositories, independently of response ordering.

submodule.description: Submodule is an initialized descendant path relative to that mapping, or empty for the mapped root.

DiffResp.description: DiffResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/diff.

DiffStat.description: DiffStat summarises the changes in a branch relative to its base.

DshSettings.description: DshSettings holds account settings for DeepSeek Harness tasks.

ErrorCode.description: ErrorCode is a machine-readable API error identifier.

EventAsk.description: EventAsk is emitted when the agent asks the user a question.

EventBackgroundCommand.description:
EventBackgroundCommand reports one harness-native detached shell command's
folded lifecycle. ExitCode is the command's numeric outcome when the harness
reported one; OutputRef is an opaque harness-owned output reference, not a
caic resource.

wakesAgent.description:
WakesAgent marks a command whose end the harness delivers to the agent in
a turn it starts by itself. Only such a running command keeps the task
running; another one stays visible while the task waits.

watch.description:
Watch marks a command that only relays events to the agent, such as
Claude Code's Monitor tool. A running watch never keeps the task running.

EventBackgroundRetired.description:
EventBackgroundRetired reports that the harness stopped listing a running
native subagent or background command without reporting its outcome. ID
matches EventNativeSubagent.ID or EventBackgroundCommand.ID. A running card
with that ID becomes unknown; other cards are unchanged.

EventChangeStat.description: EventChangeStat summarizes a completed turn's net committed change.

EventCommitSnapshot.description:
EventCommitSnapshot records the exact committed repository branch tips
fetched from the runtime when a turn finishes.

EventCost.description: EventCost is one completed turn's reported or API-equivalent estimated cost.

EventCostSource.description:
EventCostSource distinguishes harness-reported cost from a token-price estimate.

- `estimated`: EventCostEstimated is calculated from model token prices.
- `reported`: EventCostReported is supplied by the harness.

EventDiffStat.description: EventDiffStat is emitted when the relay reports updated diff statistics.

EventError.description: EventError reports an agent subprocess failure.

EventFileChange.description: EventFileChange is one changed file rendered from a unified patch.

EventInit.description:
EventInit is emitted once at the start of a session. It includes a Harness
field so the client knows which backend produced the stream.

reportedEffort.description: Thinking effort (e.g. "low", "medium", "high", "max"). Empty when not supported.

EventKind.description: EventKind identifies the type of SSE event.

EventLog.description: EventLog is a provisioning/startup log line from the runtime backend.

EventMessage.description: EventMessage is one backend-neutral message in cached history and its live stream.

EventMessageSource.description:
EventMessageSource identifies the provider origin of any normalized event.
AgentID and DelegationToolUseID identify child ownership independently of native
item identity. RootThreadID is an authoritative session owner when reported.
Fields remain absent when the harness does not supply them.

EventNativeSubagent.description:
EventNativeSubagent is one lifecycle update for a harness native subagent.
ID and GroupID are opaque harness identities. Optional fields remain absent
when the harness did not expose them.

background.description:
Background reports that the harness launched the delegation detached from
the parent turn, so it can outlive that turn's result.

kind.description:
Kind names the agent definition the harness reports, such as Claude's
subagent_type. It is absent when the harness reports none.

runID.description: RunID distinguishes resumed runs and sorts in execution order per ID.

EventNativeSubagentScope.description: EventNativeSubagentScope distinguishes a single agent from aggregate batch evidence.

EventNativeSubagentStatus.description: EventNativeSubagentStatus is the observed native lifecycle reported by a harness.

EventRateLimit.description: EventRateLimit is emitted when the agent's rate limit status changes.

isUsingOverage.description: True when extra/overage usage is active.

overageResetsAt.description: When overage resets; zero if not using overage.

resetsAt.description: When the limit resets; zero if unknown.

EventRateLimitStatus.description:
EventRateLimitStatus describes whether a rate-limited request was accepted
or rejected.

EventRepositoryCommit.description:
EventRepositoryCommit identifies one immutable repository branch tip in a
commit snapshot.

branchName.description: BranchName is the short local branch name, such as "main" or "caic-1".

commitHash.description: CommitHash is the full Git object ID of the branch tip.

repositoryPath.description: RepositoryPath is the repository's absolute path inside the task runtime.

EventResult.description: EventResult reports the end of an agent turn.

pendingToolUseIDs.description: PendingToolUseIDs identifies calls in this result's scope still running at the prompt response.

EventSkillLoad.description:
EventSkillLoad is emitted when a skill enters the main agent's context. A
failed call and a subagent's load emit none; an inferred load is emitted
once the tool that opened the file succeeds.

path.description: SKILL.md in the task runtime; empty when the harness did not report it.

EventStats.description: EventStats is a runtime resource usage snapshot emitted periodically.

cpuCeiling.description: Configured upper bound in CPU units; null when unknown. Excludes inherited limits and process affinity.

cpuError.description: Runtime CPU metadata observation failure; usage samples remain usable.

cpuPerc.description: 100% is one fully busy logical CPU.

cpuQuota.description: Explicit quota in CPU units; zero is unrestricted, null is unknown.

runtimeCPUs.description: Owning runtime's logical CPU count; null when unknown.

EventSubagentEnd.description:
EventSubagentEnd is emitted when a subagent task completes, fails, or stops.
It is the legacy harness-agnostic shape: no current parser produces it, and
clients should render EventNativeSubagent instead. It stays in the v1 event
union and the generated SDKs so existing clients that switch on these kinds
keep compiling.

EventSubagentSpawn.description: EventSubagentSpawn is one backend-normalized subagent invocation.

EventSubagentStart.description:
EventSubagentStart is emitted when a subagent task begins. It is the legacy
harness-agnostic shape: no current parser produces it, and clients should
render EventNativeSubagent instead. It stays in the v1 event union and the
generated SDKs so existing clients that switch on these kinds keep compiling.

EventSyncActivity.description:
EventSyncActivity is one record of a push attempt. Events with the same
SyncID belong to one attempt: a start, output chunks in order, then an end.
Fields that the Phase does not own are absent.

branch.description: Branch is the destination branch of the first repository. Start only.

output.description:
Output is a chunk of the pre-push hook output, or the truncation notice
when Truncated is set. Output only.

status.description: Status, Error and DurationMS describe the outcome. End only.

target.description: Target is the kind of sync, "origin" or "default". Start only.

EventSyncActivityPhase.description: EventSyncActivityPhase identifies which part of a sync attempt an event reports.

EventSyncActivityStatus.description: EventSyncActivityStatus is the outcome of a finished sync attempt.

EventSystem.description: EventSystem is a harness or caic system event that clients present.

contextTokensAfter.description:
ContextTokensAfter is the context size the harness reported after a
compact_boundary, measured or estimated. Zero means it did not report it.

contextTokensBefore.description:
ContextTokensBefore is the context size the harness reported before a
compact_boundary. Zero means the harness did not report it.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail (e.g. model names for model_rerouted).

EventSystemSubtype.description:
EventSystemSubtype identifies a system event. The server sends only these
values, so clients can present every one of them.

- `api_error`: EventSystemSubtypeAPIError reports a failed model API request.
- `compact_boundary`: EventSystemSubtypeCompactBoundary marks a context compaction.
- `compact_error`: EventSystemSubtypeCompactError reports a failed or cancelled compaction.
- `compact_start`: EventSystemSubtypeCompactStart reports a compaction in progress.
- `context_cleared`: EventSystemSubtypeContextCleared marks a cleared conversation context.
- `error`: EventSystemSubtypeError reports a harness failure described by Detail.
- `input_delivery_failed`: EventSystemSubtypeInputDeliveryFailed reports a prompt that was not delivered.
- `model_rerouted`: EventSystemSubtypeModelRerouted reports a model change described by Detail.
- `notice`: EventSystemSubtypeNotice reports informational text held in Detail.

EventText.description: EventText is an assistant text block.

phase.description: Phase is the harness-provided text phase, such as commentary or final_answer.

EventTextDelta.description: EventTextDelta is a streaming text fragment from --include-partial-messages.

EventThinking.description: EventThinking is an assistant thinking block.

EventThinkingDelta.description: EventThinkingDelta is a streaming thinking fragment.

EventTodo.description: EventTodo is emitted when the agent writes/updates its todo list.

EventToolInputKind.description:
EventToolInputKind identifies a normalized tool input view.

- `fileChanges`: EventToolInputFileChanges renders changed files as unified patches.
- `subagents`: EventToolInputSubagents renders one or more spawned subagents.

EventToolInputView.description:
EventToolInputView is a backend-normalized rendering model for known tool
inputs. It keeps harness-specific tool schemas out of clients.

EventToolOutputDelta.description:
EventToolOutputDelta is a streaming output fragment from a running tool.
Codex only: emitted for Bash stdout (item/commandExecution/outputDelta) and
MCP tool progress messages (item/mcpToolCall/progress).

EventToolResult.description: EventToolResult is emitted when a tool call completes.

interrupted.description:
Interrupted is true when the server closed a call that was still open
when its agent process exited or its task settled. The tool reported
neither a result nor an error.

EventToolUse.description: EventToolUse is emitted when the assistant invokes a tool.

background.description: True when the tool runs in the background (Bash/Agent run_in_background).

detail.description: Backend-normalized short display detail for tool headers.

inputTruncated.description: True when Input was omitted due to size; fetch via GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/tool/{toolUseID}.

inputView.description: Backend-normalized structured input for tool-card rendering.

EventUsage.description:
EventUsage reports token usage and independent native context occupancy.
ReasoningOutputTokens is a subset of OutputTokens for extended thinking (Claude)
or reasoning summaries (Codex). Zero when the harness does not report it.

contextUsed.description: Absent when native occupancy is unknown.

EventWidget.description: EventWidget is emitted when the agent produces a complete HTML widget.

EventWidgetDelta.description: EventWidgetDelta is a streaming HTML fragment for progressive widget rendering.

FileDiffResp.description: FileDiffResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/diff/file.

Forge.description:
Forge identifies the code hosting forge.
Values must match forge.Kind constants.

ForgeCheck.description: ForgeCheck describes a CI check run with its status, conclusion, and timing.

ForgePRState.description: ForgePRState is the state of a pull/merge request.

ForkTaskReq.description: ForkTaskReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/fork.

display.description: Override virtual display; nil means inherit from source.

effort.description: Override thinking effort; empty means inherit from source.

extraRepos.description: Additional repos to map into the fork.

gitHubToken.description: Override gitHubToken; nil means inherit from source.

harness.description: Override harness; empty means inherit from source.

model.description: Override model; empty means inherit from source.

prompt.description: Initial prompt for the forked task.

sudo.description: Override sudo; nil means inherit from source.

tailscale.description: Override Tailscale; nil means inherit from source. Enabling it requires Config.TailscaleAvailable.

usb.description: Override USB; nil means inherit from source.

GitCommit.description: GitCommit describes one commit unique to either side of a repository's comparison branch.

behind.description: Present on the comparison branch and missing from HEAD.

GitFileStatus.description: GitFileStatus describes one uncommitted repository path.

newSize.description: NewSize is the binary post-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

oldSize.description: OldSize is the binary pre-image byte size, or -1 for text files.

GitOperation.description: GitOperation identifies an in-progress Git operation in a task repository.

GitRepositoryState.description: GitRepositoryState summarizes the compact Git state of one task repository.

repository.description: Repository indexes the task's mapped repositories, independently of response ordering.

stale.description: Last known data retained after a failed refresh.

submodule.description: Submodule is an initialized descendant path relative to that mapping, or empty for the mapped root.

GitRepositoryStatus.description: GitRepositoryStatus describes the checked-out state of one task repository.

repository.description: Repository indexes the task's mapped repositories, independently of response ordering.

submodule.description: Submodule is an initialized descendant path relative to that mapping, or empty for the mapped root.

Harness.description:
Harness identifies the coding agent harness.
Values must match harness.Name constants.

HarnessInfo.description: HarnessInfo is the JSON representation of an available harness.

logoUrl.description: Absolute URL path to the harness logo, e.g. "/logos/codex.svg"; empty when none exists.

quotaGroup.description: Shared quota source; empty when harness usage cannot be inferred.

HarnessSettings.description: HarnessSettings groups the independently configurable agent harnesses.

HistoryActivity.description:
HistoryActivity is one native subagent's payload-free lifecycle and routing
state. Prompt, result, and child transcripts are fetched through the finite
activity resource only on disclosure. BodyThrough is a stable finite prefix
containing all actor payload and ownership observations known at the
manifest snapshot. Unrelated task records do not change it, allowing
disclosures to reuse the HTTP cache. OwnershipThrough advances only for
related routing/namespace observations; clients use it to distinguish
ownership revisions from new actor output.

kind.description:
Kind names the agent definition the harness reports, such as Claude's
subagent_type. It is absent when the harness reports none.

runID.description: RunID distinguishes resumed runs and sorts in execution order per ID.

sectionID.description:
SectionID identifies the body containing the earliest actual lifecycle or
resolved transcript origin, including an unfinished turn carried forward.

HistoryBackgroundCommand.description:
HistoryBackgroundCommand is a detached command's folded, payload-free
lifecycle. Clients attach it to the tool call identified by Source and
ToolUseID; OutputRef names the container file holding its output.

HistoryBootstrap.description:
HistoryBootstrap identifies the raw prefix captured with a HistoryManifest.
ResourceBase scopes immutable resources to the account, projection version,
and task generation. Generation changes on server restart/task replacement;
a stale reference returns 409 and requires manifest rediscovery.
RecordsPerChunk defines fixed raw-record page alignment for section slices.

HistoryCheckpoint.description:
HistoryCheckpoint advances through all outputs of a physical record,
including a record with zero outputs. Cursor is opaque; it encodes projection
version, generation, raw record and either output index or end-of-record.
SSE resumes strictly after it. The Last-Event-ID header overrides the initial
cursor query on reconnect. Named stats events never replace this raw cursor.

HistoryEvent.description:
HistoryEvent is an immutable normalized output; the identity is scoped to the
projection version and timeline generation supplied by HistoryBootstrap.

HistoryManifest.description:
HistoryManifest discovers context sections without downloading their bodies.
Metadata is mutable at Bootstrap.Through; bodies are immutable finite slices.

HistoryMetadata.description:
HistoryMetadata contains compact task-wide facts needed without archived
bodies. Setup bounds the separately disclosed, filtered getHistorySetup
resource; it must not be fetched as an unfiltered slice. InitialInput
identifies the first root input, permitting prompt deduplication by position.

routingRevision.description: RoutingRevision changes when earlier delegated ownership may have changed.

HistoryPosition.description:
HistoryPosition identifies one normalized output in a one-based physical raw
record. Index is zero-based across every output of that record. Metadata and
zero-output controls occupy record IDs too; IDs are not semantic event counts.

HistoryReset.description: HistoryReset tells an SSE client to close the stream and rediscover bootstrap.

HistoryRoute.description:
HistoryRoute is one authoritative delegation relation or namespace observation.
An absent AgentID records a namespace that participates in ambiguity checks.

HistoryRunningTurn.description:
HistoryRunningTurn is the root turn in progress: a root prompt or root
activity started it, and no root result has ended it yet. Number is one past
the last completed HistoryTurn, and StartedAt follows the HistoryTurn rules,
so the turn keeps both when it completes. SectionID is the context it runs
in; compaction can move it to a later one. A turn stops running when the
harness process exits without ending it: the turn does not complete, and a
later root prompt or activity resumes it from the same start.

HistorySection.description:
HistorySection describes one root context. Only the final section is current.
Boundary and EndBoundary contain init/system metadata, never transcript text.

HistorySlice.description:
HistorySlice selects inclusive normalized positions, independently of raw
chunk alignment. An absent slice denotes an empty section.

HistoryStats.description:
HistoryStats contains the bounded runtime ring, oldest first.
Replace samples sharing a timestamp: disk usage can revise the latest sample.
These host observations are separate from immutable raw task history.

retained.description:
Retained is the ring's capacity: the server keeps at most this many
latest samples, so a full ring has dropped older ones. Clients keep as
many while live samples arrive.

HistoryToolTiming.description: HistoryToolTiming aggregates completed tools across root and child actors.

HistoryTurn.description:
HistoryTurn retains numeric invocation facts independently of transcript
lifetime. SectionID associates the turn with its context. Pricing is obtained
separately through getHistoryCosts using the embedded exact position.

Number counts root turns from 1 across every context section of the task;
delegated child results are not turns. StartedAt is the first root prompt or
root activity after the previous root result, as in the task's turn metrics.
A turn the harness queues by itself, such as one delivering the end of
background work, starts at its first root activity. Compaction keeps the
start; a context clear discards it, and so does a failed delivery of the
starting prompt before root output accepted it. A turn without any root
prompt or activity starts at its result. At is the result. DurationMS is the
harness-reported turn duration, else the time from StartedAt to At, as in
the task's turn metrics. WaitMS is the time from At to the prompt at
WaitInput, which starts the next turn.
Effort is the root reasoning effort reported by the last init.
ContextTokens is the root context size when the turn ended, as the task's
context meter measures it: the native occupancy when the harness reports it,
else the input context of the last root API call. Zero means unknown.

HistoryTurnCall.description:
HistoryTurnCall is one model API call in a turn, by the root agent or a
child actor. Number counts the turn's calls from 1 in the order the harness
reported them, which is the timeline's order. AtMS is when the harness
reported the call, in milliseconds from the turn start: a call reports its
usage when it ends, so AtMS is the end of the model time that produced it.

The call's context is its input classes summed. ContextWindow is absent
when unknown; root calls without their own report use the window the turn
reports. Cost is absent when the call cannot be priced. It is reported when
the harness prices each call, and otherwise estimated from model token
prices, even when the harness reports the turn's total.

HistoryTurnCallOmission.description: HistoryTurnCallOmission sums the token classes of the calls a timeline omits.

HistoryTurnEstimate.description:
HistoryTurnEstimate is a revalidated price for a canonical result. TotalUSD
includes the prefix so session-cumulative reports retain their meaning. Model
is the authoritative root model at the result, including reroutes, even when
pricing is unknown; canonical output bytes are unchanged.

HistoryTurnOmission.description:
HistoryTurnOmission summarizes the spans of one kind that a timeline omits.
DurationMS sums their durations within the turn, which can overlap: a span
without an end, or one that outlives the turn, counts up to the turn's end.

HistoryTurnSpan.description:
HistoryTurnSpan is one interval of a turn timeline, in milliseconds from the
turn start. EndMS is absent when the span has no observed end: a tool call
still open when the turn ended or still running, a subagent or command whose
Status is running or unknown, or the provisional model span of a running
turn. A subagent or command can end after the turn: EndMS then exceeds the
turn duration.

The identity locates the span's transcript item. A tool span has Source and
ToolUseID, which scope the call as tool cards do. A command span has
CommandID, plus the Source and ToolUseID of the call that launched it. A
subagent span has ActivityID, a HistoryActivity ID; a tool or command span by
a child actor names its owning activity there when known. A model span has
only times.

Label is the tool name, subagent label, or command label; Detail is the tool
card's short detail. Status is completed, failed, or interrupted for a tool;
subagents and commands use their HistoryActivity and HistoryBackgroundCommand
status values.

HistoryTurnSpanKind.description:
HistoryTurnSpanKind names the lane of a turn timeline span.

- `background`: HistoryTurnSpanKindBackground is a detached command started in the turn.
- `model`: HistoryTurnSpanKindModel is turn time that no root tool call covers. It is inferred: harnesses report a model call only when it ends, so this time also contains harness overhead between calls. In a running turn, the model span after the last root tool call is provisional and has no EndMS.
- `subagent`: HistoryTurnSpanKindSubagent is a native subagent started in the turn.
- `tool`: HistoryTurnSpanKindTool is a tool call by the root agent or a child actor.

HistoryTurnTimeline.description:
HistoryTurnTimeline places one root turn's work on one time axis of
DurationMS from StartedAt. For a completed turn, StartedAt and EndedAt match
its HistoryTurn's StartedAt and At. For the HistoryRunningTurn, EndedAt is absent and the axis
ends at the later of the server's clock and the turn's latest observation
when the server derived the timeline; open spans and model time then grow
with each request. It includes tool calls
that start in the turn, from the root agent and from child actors, and the
subagents and detached commands that start in it, including those that
outlive it. Model spans fill the turn time outside root tool calls; ModelMS
is their exact total. Background work and child calls run beside the root
agent, so they do not reduce model time.

Spans holds at most 500 spans sorted by start: the longest ones, with spans
lacking an end kept first. Omitted counts the shorter spans left out, per
kind. The server derives the timeline from its own history index, so archived
context sections need no transcript download. Durations within the turn count
up to the axis end.

Calls holds at most 500 API calls sorted by Number: those with the most
tokens. OmittedCalls sums the rest. Calls is empty when the harness reports
usage only per turn. Unattributed sums the root agent's usage reports that
cover no single call, such as cumulative deltas spanning several requests
after a missed event; they are not priced per call. Tools sums every tool
call in the turn by name, longest total first, including calls that Spans
omits.

HistoryTurnTokens.description:
HistoryTurnTokens are disjoint token classes. The three input classes sum to
a call's input context; ReasoningOutputTokens is a subset of OutputTokens.

HistoryTurnTool.description:
HistoryTurnTool sums one tool name's calls that start in the turn, by the
root agent and child actors. DurationMS and LongestMS count only time within
the turn: a call without an end counts up to the turn's end. Concurrent calls
overlap, so durations can sum to more than the turn.

ImageConstraints.description: ImageConstraints describes image-picker byte budgets and supported MIME types.

ImageRefreshReq.description: ImageRefreshReq identifies the runtime whose specialized image is refreshed.

ImageRefreshState.description: ImageRefreshState describes the lifecycle of a specialized image refresh.

ImageRefreshStatus.description: ImageRefreshStatus describes the current or most recent image refresh.

InputImage.description:
InputImage identifies a prompt attachment's original, thumbnail, and preview.
To submit images, use multipart/form-data with a first "request" part holding
the JSON request. Each Prompt.Images URL is "cid:image-N" referencing the
subsequent binary part named "image-N", in zero-based image order. Text-only
requests use JSON. Responses contain immutable task-owned download URLs.

previewURL.description: Inline preview, at most 480px on either axis.

thumbnailURL.description: Compact thumbnail, at most 96px on either axis.

InputReq.description: InputReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/input.

queue.description: Append to the pending prompt, or deliver when waiting instead of steering the active turn.

LocalUsage.description: LocalUsage is the aggregated cost across all tasks within recent time windows.

LocalWindow.description: LocalWindow is the aggregated local cost for a rolling time window.

costKnown.description: True when all included billed usage has known cost; otherwise costUSD is a known subtotal.

MetricResource.description: MetricResource identifies the process that produced the observations.

host.description: Host is the machine the process runs on, when known.

serviceName.description: ServiceName is the emitting binary, such as "caic".

serviceVersion.description: ServiceVersion is the build version, when known.

MetricSeries.description:
MetricSeries describes aggregated measurements sharing one name, kind, unit,
outcome, and attribute set.

attrs.description:
Attrs are the bounded dimensions that separate this series from others
sharing its name and outcome, such as the container runtime. Omitted when
the measurement has no dimensions.

count.description: Count is the number of recorded measurements.

kind.description:
Kind is the OpenTelemetry instrument kind: "histogram", "counter",
"updowncounter", or "gauge". It decides which statistics are meaningful.

last.description: Last is the most recently recorded amount, in Unit.

max.description: Max is the largest retained amount, in Unit.

min.description: Min is the smallest retained amount, in Unit.

name.description:
Name is the measurement identifier, such as "container.launch" or
"mcp.tool.task_create".

p50.description: P50 is the median retained amount, in Unit.

p95.description: P95 is the 95th percentile retained amount, in Unit.

samples.description: Samples is the number of retained measurements used for the percentiles.

sum.description: Sum is the total of every recorded amount, in Unit.

unit.description:
Unit is the unit the amounts are expressed in, in UCUM notation: "s" for
seconds, "By" for bytes, "1" for a dimensionless count.

MetricsResp.description:
MetricsResp is the historical and live aggregate for GET
/api/caic/v1/server/metrics.

resource.description: Resource identifies the process that produced the observations.

series.description: Series holds per-operation aggregates, slowest p95 first.

since.description: Since is the earliest retained observation in the aggregate.

Model.description: Model describes the configuration choices supported by a harness model.

MountMappingResp.description: MountMappingResp represents a general host-to-runtime directory mount.

containerPath.description: ContainerPath is optional; empty uses the matching home-relative HostPath.

resolvedContainerPath.description: ResolvedContainerPath is the runtime target after applying the ContainerPath default.

OAuthGrantResp.description: OAuthGrantResp describes one user-authorized remote MCP client grant.

OAuthGrantStatus.description: OAuthGrantStatus is the user-visible state of a connected OAuth client grant.

OAuthGrantsResp.description: OAuthGrantsResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/oauth/grants.

OpenCodeSettings.description: OpenCodeSettings configures native OpenCode compaction budgets for new tasks.

bufferTokens.description: BufferTokens reserves context headroom before compaction. Null uses native configuration.

keepRecentTokens.description: KeepRecentTokens is the recent history retained alongside the summary. Null uses native configuration.

PendingInput.description: PendingInput is a task's single pending prompt without embedded image payloads.

delivered.description:
Delivered means the agent accepted the prompt but clearing the durable pending record failed.
Clients must not offer to edit and resend it, which would duplicate delivery.

PiSettings.description: PiSettings configures native Pi compaction budgets for new tasks.

keepRecentTokens.description: KeepRecentTokens is the recent history retained verbatim. Null uses native configuration.

reserveTokens.description: ReserveTokens leaves this many context tokens free before compaction. Null uses native configuration.

Platform.description: Platform selects the runtime CPU architecture.

PreferencesResp.description: PreferencesResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/server/preferences.

ProcessInfo.description: ProcessInfo describes a single process running inside the task runtime instance.

command.description: Command is the full command line reported by the runtime.

cpu.description: CPU is the lifetime-average CPU percentage reported by ps (100% per core).

cpuTime.description: CPUTime is the cumulative user and system CPU time in nanoseconds.

mem.description: Mem is the percentage of physical memory used at the time of inspection.

nice.description: Nice is the process niceness value.

openFDs.description: OpenFDs is the number of open file descriptors, if available.

pgrp.description: PGRP is the process group ID.

ppid.description: PPID is the parent process ID.

priority.description: Priority is the kernel scheduling priority.

rssBytes.description: RSSBytes is the resident set size in bytes.

startedAt.description: StartedAt is when the process started.

state.description: State is the process state and modifiers reported by the runtime.

threads.description: Threads is the number of threads in the process.

user.description: User is the effective user name.

ProcessListResp.description: ProcessListResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/processes.

Prompt.description: Prompt bundles user text with optional images.

ProviderAuthKind.description: ProviderAuthKind identifies a provider authentication method.

ProviderFetchStatus.description:
ProviderFetchStatus describes whether provider quota data is current enough
to support availability claims.

- `error`: ProviderFetchStatusError means the latest provider refresh failed.
- `fresh`: ProviderFetchStatusFresh means the snapshot is within the provider cache TTL.
- `stale`: ProviderFetchStatusStale means the snapshot is older than the provider cache TTL.
- `unknown`: ProviderFetchStatusUnknown means the provider has no timestamped snapshot.

ProviderQuota.description: ProviderQuota is the quota data for one provider.

balance.description:
Balance is the provider's money snapshot. Some providers, such as
Anthropic, report it as "extra usage" on top of the subscription
instead of a prepaid wallet balance.

logoUrl.description: absolute URL path to provider SVG, e.g. "/logos/anthropic.svg"

pricingPhase.description:
PricingPhase reports time-dependent pricing as of the snapshot:
"peak", "peak-soon", or "off-peak". Empty when the provider's pricing
does not vary by time of day.

pricingTransitionAt.description:
PricingTransitionAt is when PricingPhase next changes; zero for
off-peak. Clients should interpolate between snapshots, which arrive
at the usage cache TTL cadence.

unassessedWindows.description: UnassessedWindows do not carry a utilization fraction or prove capacity.

QuotaBalance.description:
QuotaBalance is a balance/credit snapshot from any provider. When the
provider also reports pay-as-you-go spending (Anthropic-style extra credits
or a spend cap), the spend fields carry that information too.

extraEnabled.description: ExtraEnabled reports whether the pay-as-you-go spend cap is active.

QuotaProvider.description: QuotaProvider identifies a monitored quota source.

QuotaRateLimit.description: QuotaRateLimit is a single rate-limit window snapshot from any provider.

label.description: Display label; does not identify the bucket.

RefreshHarnessReq.description: RefreshHarnessReq is the request for POST /api/caic/v1/server/harnesses/{harness}/refresh.

Repo.description: Repo is the JSON representation of a discovered repo.

RepoBranchesResp.description: RepoBranchesResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/server/repos/branches.

RepoSpec.description: RepoSpec describes a repository to associate with a task at creation time.

ResourceLevel.description: ResourceLevel classifies host usage as a share of machine capacity.

RestartReq.description: RestartReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/restart.

RevokeOAuthGrantReq.description: RevokeOAuthGrantReq is the request for POST /api/caic/v1/oauth/grants/{grantID}/revoke.

Role.description:
Role identifies a user's effective instance authority.
Values must match auth.Role constants.

RuntimeInfo.description: RuntimeInfo is the JSON representation of an available task runtime backend.

sudoPassword.description: SudoPassword is the random sudo password, only populated when Sudo is true.

tailscale.description: Tailscale URL (https://fqdn) or "true" if enabled but FQDN unknown.

RuntimeSettings.description: RuntimeSettings holds CPU configuration for a single runtime.

containerPlatform.description:
ContainerPlatform selects the runtime CPU architecture. Empty means use
the host's native platform. Valid values are linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.

maxCPUs.description:
MaxCPUs limits the number of CPU cores the runtime instance may use.
Zero means use the runtime default: leave two CPUs of headroom where
possible, allowing at least two CPUs when available.

SafetyIssue.description: SafetyIssue describes a potential problem detected before pushing to origin.

ServerHealth.description:
ServerHealth is compact last-observed machine health. Time is omitted before the first
successful sample. CPUPerc uses 100% per fully busy logical CPU; CPUCount is
the whole-machine capacity. Levels classify the latest successful sample and are
omitted before it; CPULevel is also omitted while CPUCount is zero. High flags are true when the level
is warning or high. Sampling errors and collection gaps retain levels, flags, and
readings until a successful sample updates them. Error reports sampling failures
separately; Time identifies the last successful measurement.

SessionResp.description: SessionResp describes an active host login without exposing its credential.

SessionsResp.description: SessionsResp lists the signed-in user's sessions.

SetTailscaleKeyReq.description: SetTailscaleKeyReq is the request for POST /api/caic/v1/server/tailscale-key.

SetTailscaleTagsReq.description: SetTailscaleTagsReq is the request for POST /api/caic/v1/server/tailscale-tags.

tags.description:
Tags replace the node tags of new tasks; none restores "tag:caic". Each is
"tag:" followed by a letter, then letters, digits, or dashes.

SignalProcessReq.description: SignalProcessReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/processes/{pid}/signal.

StatusResp.description: StatusResp is a common response for mutation endpoints.

StreamHeartbeat.description: StreamHeartbeat proves transport liveness independently of mutable observations.

time.description: UTC server observation time for this heartbeat.

SyncReq.description: SyncReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/sync.

SyncResp.description: SyncResp is the response for POST /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/sync.

prNumber.description: non-zero if a PR/MR was created

status.description: "synced", "blocked", or "empty" when no destination ref moved

SyncTarget.description:
SyncTarget selects where to push changes.

- `branch`: Push to the task's own branch (default).
- `default`: Push existing commits to the repo's default branch.

SystemSample.description:
SystemSample measures the machine running caic, including all processes.
Memory excludes available/reclaimable pages. Network sums all interfaces,
including virtual interfaces; traffic crossing several interfaces is counted on each.
Disk measures the filesystem containing the server working directory.

SystemStatsResp.description:
SystemStatsResp contains up to five minutes of five-second samples.
Error describes the most recent sampling failure; retained samples remain available.

TailscaleKeyResp.description:
TailscaleKeyResp describes the active Tailscale API access token without
revealing it.

availableUntil.description:
AvailableUntil is when new tasks stop being able to enable Tailscale,
ahead of ExpiresAt. Zero when Error is set or the token never expires.

configKeyID.description:
ConfigKeyID identifies the configured token that removing a saved token
falls back to; empty when none is configured.

error.description: Error is why new tasks cannot enable Tailscale now; empty when they can.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is zero when the token never expires or its expiry is unknown.

keyID.description:
KeyID is the token's ID in the Tailscale admin console; empty when
Source is none or the token is malformed.

tags.description:
Tags are the tags of new tasks' Tailscale nodes; "tag:caic" unless an
administrator saved others.

TailscaleKeySource.description:
TailscaleKeySource identifies where the active Tailscale API access token
comes from.

- `config`: TAILSCALE_API_KEY from config.toml or the environment
- `saved`: saved by an administrator

Task.description: Task is the JSON representation sent to the frontend.

activeInputTokens.description: Last turn's non-cached input tokens (including cache creation).

autoCompactTokenLimit.description: Auto-compaction threshold (tokens), or zero if unknown.

background.description: Running background work; absent when none runs.

backgroundItems.description: Short preview of running work; Background has the full counts.

cacheTTLSeconds.description: Effective cache TTL from last API call (seconds); 0 = unknown.

contextUsed.description: Native context occupancy; absent when unknown; zero is a reported empty context.

costComplete.description: True when costUSD covers all observed billed usage.

costKnown.description: True when any cost is known; costUSD may be a subtotal.

owner.description: username of creator; omitted in no-auth mode

rateLimit.description: Current quota block resolved by the backend.

repoStates.description: Pushed compact per-repo Git state from the latest diff probe.

resourceUsage.description: Latest runtime sample; absent before sampling. Not persisted.

stateUpdatedAt.description: When the task state last changed.

stoppedDiskUsedBytes.description: Final writable-layer size retained by a stopped task, or -1 when unavailable.

turnError.description: Latest turn failure, cleared by a successful or new turn.

turnStartedAt.description: When the current turn started; zero when not running.

commands.description: Detached commands that are not watches, waking the agent or not.

watches.description: Commands that only relay events, such as Claude Code's Monitor tool.

TaskBackgroundItem.description: TaskBackgroundItem describes one running command, agent, or watch.

label.description: Preview of the harness label, or the item ID when unnamed.

startedAt.description: Start of the agent's current run, when known.

TaskBackgroundItemKind.description: TaskBackgroundItemKind identifies the kind of running background work.

TaskDiffIndexResp.description: TaskDiffIndexResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/diff/index.

TaskDirEntry.description: TaskDirEntry is one child of a listed directory.

modified.description: Modified is the modification time, absent when the runtime cannot report it.

size.description: Size is the reported size in bytes; a directory reports its own metadata.

TaskDirListing.description: TaskDirListing is the raw endpoint's directory representation.

entries.description: Entries are the immediate children, sorted by name.

path.description: Path is the resolved container directory.

truncated.description: Truncated reports that entries were dropped at the runtime's limit.

TaskHandoffResp.description:
TaskHandoffResp contains an editable prompt for continuing a source task in
a fresh agent session.

TaskHistoryStreamError.description: TaskHistoryStreamError reports that task history could not be replayed.

TaskInfo.description: TaskInfo is the detailed metadata response for a task.

TaskInfoCacheMount.description: TaskInfoCacheMount describes a recorded cache mount.

TaskInfoCapability.description: TaskInfoCapability describes recorded runtime capabilities and injected-token presence.

TaskInfoMount.description: TaskInfoMount describes a recorded or observed bind mount.

TaskInfoObservedRuntime.description: TaskInfoObservedRuntime describes runtime-observed instance details from the runtime adapter.

TaskInfoRecorded.description: TaskInfoRecorded holds caic-recorded task launch configuration and metadata.

TaskInfoRepo.description: TaskInfoRepo describes a repository mounted into a task runtime.

TaskListEvent.description:
TaskListEvent is a discriminated-union event for the task list SSE stream.
kind=="snapshot": Snapshot carries task data on connect and when restoration becomes complete.
Complete is present on snapshots only: false preserves prior membership and drafts;
true certifies omissions after successful runtime/history restoration and DTO conversion.
kind=="upsert":   Upsert holds a newly created task.
kind=="patch":    Patch holds only the changed fields (always includes "id") for an existing task.
kind=="focus":    Focus holds the stable task ID selected by a user-directed tool call.
kind=="delete":   Delete holds the string ID of the removed task.
kind=="repos":    Repos holds the updated repo list (emitted when default-branch CI status changes).
kind=="warning": Warning holds a categorized alert with identity and diagnostic details.
kind=="health": Health holds last-observed machine CPU/memory health for server administrators.
kind=="heartbeat": Keeps the stream observable every 15 seconds even if sampling stalls.
kind=="status":   Status holds runtime/history restoration state, emitted on connect and again whenever restoration transitions (in-progress -> completed | failed).

TaskPlan.description:
TaskPlan is the task's current root ExitPlanMode content. The identity and
content form one projection and are cleared together.

TaskRateLimit.description: TaskRateLimit is the current quota block resolved by the backend for one task.

TaskRepo.description: TaskRepo describes a repository associated with a task in the API response.

TaskRepoStatusResp.description: TaskRepoStatusResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/repo-status.

TaskStartupFailure.description: TaskStartupFailure identifies the failed startup phase and original agent diagnostic.

TaskState.description: TaskState is the lifecycle state of a task.

TaskToolInputResp.description:
TaskToolInputResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/tasks/{id}/tool/{toolUseID}.
It returns the full (untruncated) input for a tool call.

TodoItem.description: TodoItem is a single todo entry from a TodoWrite tool call.

ToolOutputContentType.description:
ToolOutputContentType identifies the type of a tool output for rendering.

- `text`: ToolOutputText indicates plain text output.
- `json`: ToolOutputJSON indicates JSON output.
- `markdown`: ToolOutputMarkdown indicates markdown output.

UnassessedQuotaWindow.description: UnassessedQuotaWindow identifies a reported bucket with unknown utilization.

UpdatePreferencesReq.description: UpdatePreferencesReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/server/preferences.

UpdateResp.description: UpdateResp is the response for POST /api/caic/v1/server/update.

UsageDashboardCacheWrite.description:
UsageDashboardCacheWrite counts cache writes for one applied lifetime.
TTLSeconds zero means the provider did not report a lifetime.

UsageDashboardCost.description:
UsageDashboardCost preserves additive cost provenance across range filters.
Signed parts retain known zeros and cancel estimates replaced by reports.
UnknownParts also marks amounts in rows whose source cannot be proven.

UsageDashboardCount.description: UsageDashboardCount is a named counter such as a skill read or tool call.

UsageDashboardDay.description:
UsageDashboardDay is the complete daily usage snapshot from the durable
cross-task rollup. Day is a UTC calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

UsageDashboardHarness.description:
UsageDashboardHarness is one coding harness's totals within a UTC day,
mirroring UsageDashboardModel plus the harness-by-model cross product so a
harness filter can still list the models used under it.

UsageDashboardModel.description:
UsageDashboardModel is one model's totals within a UTC day. It carries the
full delta fold so clients can drill every dashboard panel down to the
model; skills and repos keep the day leaderboards' distinct-task counts.

UsageDashboardRepo.description:
UsageDashboardRepo is a repository leaderboard entry for one UTC day.
Tasks is the number of distinct tasks that touched the repository.

UsageDashboardResp.description:
UsageDashboardResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/usage/dashboard.
DataSince is the first UTC day with retained usage, or empty when no usage
has been recorded yet.

UsageDashboardTokens.description:
UsageDashboardTokens separates usage totals by their prompt-cache bucket.
Input, cache writes, and cache reads are disjoint; their sum is the full
prompt context consumed by the model.

UsageDashboardToolDuration.description:
UsageDashboardToolDuration counts measured calls whose duration falls above
the previous bucket's upperMs and at most its own.

UsageDashboardToolTiming.description:
UsageDashboardToolTiming measures completed tool calls with known duration.
Buckets keeps the duration distribution that a range-wide median needs; rows
written before the distribution existed contribute counts without buckets.

UsageResp.description: UsageResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/usage.

sessionID.description: SessionID is a public identifier, never an authentication credential.

autoFixOnCIFailure.description:
AutoFixOnCIFailure automatically starts a new task to fix CI when a
task's PR CI fails and the original task can no longer receive input.
Only effective when the GitHub App is configured.

autoFixOnPROpen.description:
AutoFixOnPROpen automatically creates a task to review and fix a pull
request when it is opened or reopened via a forge webhook.

baseImage.description:
BaseImage overrides the default runtime base image. Empty means use
the default.

cacheMappings.description: CacheMappings are custom host-to-runtime directory mappings.

customMounts.description: CustomMounts are custom non-cache host-to-runtime directory mappings.

harnesses.description: Harnesses holds the settings for each configured agent harness.

purgeDelay.description:
PurgeDelay is the recovery window in nanoseconds before a stopped task is
permanently deleted.

runtimeName.description: RuntimeName is the preferred runtime backend for new tasks.

runtimeSettings.description: RuntimeSettings stores CPU architecture and limits by runtime name.

wellKnownCaches.description:
WellKnownCaches maps cache name to enabled state. Absent or false means
disabled, true means enabled. Caches are opt-in.

VersionResp.description: VersionResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/server/version.

autoUpdateEnabled.description: true when manual updates are available for this build

checkError.description: non-empty when the GitHub check failed

VoiceGatewayMetadata.description: VoiceGatewayMetadata reports structured voice gateway support.

VoiceGatewayMode.description: VoiceGatewayMode is the advertised service-side voice gateway mode.

Warning.description:
Warning is an alert episode. ID is stable across detail updates and SSE replay;
a new failure after recovery receives a new ID.

WarningCategory.description: WarningCategory identifies a warning independently of translated display text.

WarningDetail.description: WarningDetail describes a failed operation on a repository.

WebFetchReq.description: WebFetchReq is the request body for POST /api/caic/v1/web/fetch.

WebFetchResp.description: WebFetchResp is the response for POST /api/caic/v1/web/fetch.

WellKnownCache.description: WellKnownCache describes a single well-known cache.

WellKnownCachesResp.description: WellKnownCachesResp is the response for GET /api/caic/v1/server/caches.
